summary: Perma-Fix Environmental Services filed an 8-K/A on September 23, 2026, amending a September 22, 2026 Current Report to replace Exhibit 99.1, its September 2026 investor presentation, with a revised version correcting DFLAW program disclosures. Slides 9 and 16 were revised after investor inquiries; slide 16 now shows combined DFLAW waste of roughly 4,000 cubic meters and about $35 million annual revenue assuming 50% capacity in 2027, and a 2028 illustrative run rate near $97.4 million. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. No special-situation event; watch for disclosure-correction risk.
